premise: Bear cub wants to stay up all winter but keeps yawning; he sleeps in his den and Bird wakes him with the first spring song.
inspiration: Rip Van Winkle, turned: sleeping through is safe and cosy, and friends are waiting when you wake.
lesson: Resting is nothing to miss out on; friends will be there when you wake.
learning: Bears sleep through much of the winter in a den

en-US.title: Bear Cub Waits for Spring
en-US.text: The days were getting shorter and colder. [curious] {bear:enter} Bear cub, aren't you going to sleep for the winter? asked {badger:enter} Badger {badger:pulse}. {bear:face happy} Not me, said the bear cub {bear:hop}. I'm staying up to see the snow! {bear:shake 0.4} He tried very hard. {bear:live} But he yawned, and stretched his arms up high, rubbed his eyes, patted his round tummy… and nodded off. {bear:face sleeping} [giggles] Badger helped him into his cosy den, and tucked dry leaves all around. {badger:face happy} [softly] Sleep well, he said. We'll wake you in spring. {canvas:snow 0.6 9s} All winter long the snow fell, and the bear cub slept, snug and warm. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 12s} Then one morning, {bird:enter} Bird {bird:float loop 0.3} landed at the door and sang. {sfx:spring-song} Tweet, tweet, tweet! [excited] The bear cub {bear:face surprised} {bear:hop x2} opened his eyes. Is it snowing yet? {bird:face happy} [laughs] No, sleepyhead, said Bird. {bear:face happy} It's spring!

es-ES.title: El osito espera la primavera
es-ES.text: Los días eran cada vez más cortos y más fríos. [curious] {bear:enter} Osito, ¿no te vas a dormir todo el invierno?, preguntó {badger:enter} Tejón {badger:pulse}. {bear:face happy} Yo no, dijo el osito {bear:hop}. ¡Me voy a quedar despierto para ver la nieve! {bear:shake 0.4} Lo intentó con todas sus fuerzas. {bear:live} Pero bostezó, estiró los brazos bien alto, se frotó los ojos, se dio unas palmaditas en la barriga… y se quedó dormido. {bear:face sleeping} [giggles] Tejón lo ayudó a meterse en su guarida calentita, y lo arropó con hojas secas. {badger:face happy} [softly] Que duermas bien, le dijo. Te despertaremos en primavera. {canvas:snow 0.6 9s} Todo el invierno cayó la nieve, y el osito durmió, calentito y a gusto. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 12s} Hasta que una mañana, {bird:enter} Pájaro {bird:float loop 0.3} se posó en la puerta y cantó. {sfx:spring-song} ¡Pío, pío, pío! [excited] El osito {bear:face surprised} {bear:hop x2} abrió los ojos. ¿Ya está nevando? {bird:face happy} [laughs] No, dormilón, dijo Pájaro. {bear:face happy} ¡Es primavera!

spring-song.prompt: a bright little songbird singing a happy spring morning song
